title: Prompt 4 Audit — External AI Agents + Multimodal/Image Capability + Provider Experience
gateStatement: External-agent canonical abstraction, multimodal image input, the image-generation foundation and user-facing workflow, and the honest provider-experience contract are implemented, migration-applied (0073) and regression-proven across Web + Desktop. Real image-generation endpoint call and real external-agent runs were NOT executed in this gate; that is stated honestly, no fabricated availability claim is made.
scopeAssertions: No new AI engine; no parallel router; external agents and image generation ride the existing adapter/gateway abstraction.

External agents are EXTERNAL_AGENT registry rows (devin-session, manus-1.6) with session/task lifecycle wrappers; explicit intent only; pinned-but-unavailable agent is an error, never a silent normal-model substitution.
VISION (supportsVision), IMAGE_GENERATION/IMAGE_EDITING (registry markers) and EXTERNAL_AGENT (category) are distinct, non-overlapping classes.

Image generation is an explicit composer opt-in (imageRequest) flowing through generateImageCompletion; the image is persisted as a project file attached to the assistant message; clients hold only {fileId,mimeType}.
Six-state provider key machine; KEY_INVALID is never auto-upgraded to ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED; big_pickle is permanently ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED.
Keys live only in the gitignored root .env; no key material in docs, audit artifacts, or desktop shell.
Web and Desktop are the same backend + same renderer; desktop needs zero additional code for new surfaces.
No feature removal; no payment change; payment regression green.

backend/src/modules/ai/providers.ts: ExternalRunInfo, ChatChunk.image, devin/manus externalRun chunks
backend/src/modules/ai/gateway.ts: RouteOptions image/capability, eligibility filters, logUsage columns, CompletionSummary.externalRun, generateImageCompletion
backend/src/modules/conversations/service.ts + chat.ts: image columns, vision parts, image path, external-agent path + audits, mode IMAGE
frontend/src/lib/sse.ts + lib/types.ts, pages/ChatPage.tsx, components/ModelPicker.tsx: image mode/render/download, agent status, capability chips

verification.capabilityClassOf: PKG-54.1 — truthful class derivation, no provider-id heuristics
verification.providerKeyState: PKG-54.2 — big_pickle ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED, unknown MISSING_KEY, canonical 6-state, KEY_INVALID distinct from ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED

gateExitConditions: Optionally run a real image-generation call to move image capability to VERIFIED.
Provide valid Devin (and/or Manus) keys only when real external-agent runs are intended.
Re-run secret:scan and db:migrate:status after any key change.
